cohort: Women who underwent frozen embryo transfer (FET) cycles and experienced early miscarriage diagnosed by transvaginal ultrasound between January 2016 and December 2022.
finding: Surgical evacuation of early miscarriage after FET was associated with lower live birth rates, thinner endometrial lining, and higher cesarean section rates in subsequent FET cycles compared to medical evacuation.
mod_finding: The surgical management group experienced significantly higher cesarean rates in subsequent FET cycles.
